bibliographic.title: Progenitor's Folly: Killing Orders
bibliographic.author: Clinton Ma
bibliographic.description:
Progenitor's Folly: Killing Orders is a fast-paced, science-fiction thriller that puts you in the role of Miranda Gellar, a brilliant young scientist who has gone on the run from her corporate masters on the distant, colony city of New Caldonis. Help guide Miranda to safety as she attempts to stay one step ahead of the galaxy's most feared assassin!

This is the author's debut interactive fiction project and part one of a planned trilogy.

Approximate play time: 5 minutes
